action.title: Action (Check, Bookmark, UpdateComment)
action.description:
This action should be one of those:
"check" - will check of a candidate is already bookmarked
"bookmark" - will bookmark new candidate with optional comment to attach to it
"updatecomment" - this will add comment to already bookmarked candidate

candidateId.title: Candidate ID
candidateId.description: This will be the candidate id and it is required to run that action

comment.title: Comment
comment.description: This is the comment that will be attached to the bookmarked candidate
